views.description: Parts of the diagram built as their own images and page, <id>-<view>

oneOf.description: 'verb targets [duration]', e.g. 'draw a->b 700ms', or an action's name and its instances. Verbs: activate: Node starts working: pulsing ring, spinner badge; done: Node finished: check badge; fail: Node failed: red ring and cross; an active cell fails too; run: Node works for a while, then finishes: 'run api 800ms' is activate api 800ms, then done api; draw: Edge is used: the accent line draws along the path, showing the edge if it is hidden; flow: Follow a path: 'flow a -> b' is activate a, draw a->b, done a. A duration after a stop is how long it stays active ('flow a 600ms -> b'), '(b c)' is several stops side by side, and 'done' at the end finishes the last stop, which is otherwise left as it is; cells: Fill a node's cells one by one, or only some: 'cells n 2..4', 'cells n 3', 'cells n build..test'; spin: Rotate the node's glyph; 'spin n off' stops it; show: Reveal a hidden node, edge or group; hide: Hide a node, edge or group; focus: Dim everything except the targets and the edges between them; 'focus none' clears; wait: Pause
Text that changes: 'node.sub: text', 'node.title', 'node.sub.N', 'a->b.label' or 'status', each with an optional duration ('api.sub 400ms: text'). Several in one mapping change together
Effects that play together, in lockstep
'repeat 3: [...]' plays the effects 3 times; '{i}' in text is the round number
Effects that play one after another, as one lane
